metadata.accuracy: Features tagged in OpenStreetMap use their mapped node positions. Municipal services without a corresponding OSM object remain approximate.
sources: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria City Council, Las Alcaravaneras information and services pages
City Council beach information panel, used as a factual reference only

description.es: El cartel municipal señala un acceso para personas con movilidad reducida (PMR). La posición sigue de forma aproximada el símbolo del panel oficial; consulta allí las condiciones de acceso.
description.en: The City Council panel identifies an access point for people with reduced mobility (PRM). Its position follows the official panel approximately; check access conditions on site.

description.es: Zona de fútbol sobre la arena, situada entre las calles Alfredo Calderón e Ingeniero Salinas y entre los puntos de duchas mapeados. La posición es aproximada.
description.en: Beach soccer area between Alfredo Calderón and Ingeniero Salinas streets and between the mapped shower points. Position is approximate.

properties.provenance: Approximate location based on the user’s correction, OSM street geometry, mapped shower points, and OSM beach outline.

description.es: Actividad indicada en el panel oficial. El icono señala de forma aproximada el agua frente a la playa y no delimita una zona de baño.
description.en: Activity identified in the official panel. The icon approximately marks the water off the beach and does not define a bathing area.

properties.provenance: Approximate water-side point based on the supplied official beach panel and OSM beach outline; no swim boundary is mapped in OSM.

description.es: Actividad indicada en el panel oficial. El icono se coloca de forma aproximada sobre el agua y no delimita una zona de buceo.
description.en: Activity identified in the official panel. The icon is placed approximately on the water and does not define a diving area.

description.es: El icono marca el centro aproximado del polígono sport=canoe de OpenStreetMap; no señala un punto de entrada al agua.
description.en: The icon marks the approximate center of the OpenStreetMap sport=canoe polygon; it is not a water entry point.

properties.provenance: Marker position derived from the center of the OSM-mapped canoe polygon.
